selected_plan.batch_rationale: The latest feedback supports narrowing exceptional-surface acquisition and expanding controlled transfer learning. Two m202 baseline midpoints distinguish a general middle-loading association from localization toward 10/1. Three m118 measurements test the range and loading transfer of endpoint decoupling. The m74 repeat materially weakens its original reversal, so further routine surface expansion receives no allocation. Four aryl-ketone sequences test ordinary structural limits through response slopes; two benzoate curves preserve their distinct dosing contexts. The m109, indene and fused-ketone curves extend representation beyond recently mapped identities. The m168 pair supplies an exact plug-volume comparison at two ratios. Selection uses these scientific contrasts rather than numerical acquisition rankings.
selected_plan.expected_learning_value: Expected benefits are better separation of molecular offsets, onset/completion ratio slopes and conditional loading or plug-volume associations. Connected ordinary curves can reduce excessive transfer of joint onset growth to completion-dominated structures, while the m202/m118 measurements constrain consequential conditional regimes. Small measured changes would provide useful local invariance evidence, although small plug-volume differences would remain provisional without repetition. Candidate multiplicity supplies no Row weighting, and the trajectory supports no numerical estimate of retrained overall accuracy gain.
